tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Confirmed and unconfirmed balance of an address; with height or time, its confirmed balance at that point (for example at the end of a year).

tools.name: get_address_summary
tools.description: Totals for an address: balance, total received, and how many transactions sent and received.

tools.name: get_transaction_counts
tools.description: How many transactions an address has sent, received, and in total.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: An address's transactions, newest first (unconfirmed first), with the amount each one moved for the address and the price at the time (USD unless currency is given). Without filters, pages by number; with any filter (block or time range, direction), pages by cursor: pass next_cursor back until it's

tools.name: get_unspent_outputs
tools.description: The coins (unspent outputs) an address can spend, oldest first.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: A transaction: confirmations, block, fee, inputs and outputs (is_change marks outputs paying back to an input address).

tools.name: get_transaction_status
tools.description: A transaction's status: pending, mined, replaced (another transaction spent one of its inputs, as in a fee bump or double spend; replaced_by names it), dropped, or expired (Zcash). SoChain remembers a removal for about a day; after that, or for a transaction it never saw, the status is unknown.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: A block by height or hash: time, transactions, size, reward, fees, miner.

tools.name: get_latest_blocks
tools.description: The ten newest blocks with their size, transaction count, reward and miner.

tools.name: get_best_block_hash
tools.description: The hash of the newest block.

tools.name: get_network_info
tools.description: Current height, hashrate, and the mempool: waiting transactions, size, and projected next blocks with fee rates.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: The price in USD (or another currency): the current price, or the UTC-day opening price for a past unix time.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Classify a search string: an address, a transaction ID, a block hash or a block height.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: A chart series: tx_count, fees_total, fees_median, block_size, difficulty, hashrate, supply, price_usd, tx_per_min, block_interval, mempool_txs, mempool_bytes, pool_share, holder_share, new_addresses, active_addresses, transfers, lookalikes, on LTC and LTCTEST mweb_pool (coins in MWEB) and mweb_flow

tools.name: is_valid_address
tools.description: Whether a string is a valid address on the network.

tools.name: get_rich_list
tools.description: The largest holders: the top 1,000 addresses by confirmed balance, with each one's share of the supply, transactions, first and last activity, and change over 24 hours and 7 days.

tools.name: get_address_rank
tools.description: Where an address stands among the largest holders (exact within the top 10,000) and its share of the supply.

tools.name: get_balance_history
tools.description: An address's confirmed balance by day, week or month, with what came in and went out in each and how many transactions did each. Without an API key at most 2,000 points (daily: the most recent days unless from says otherwise); with one, 20,000.

tools.name: get_address_poisoning
tools.description: Whether an address was targeted by address poisoning: look-alike addresses that sent it dust, imitating an address it really paid or was paid by, so a careless copy from its history pays the scammer. Each finding names the look-alike, whom it imitates and the real payment.

tools.name: get_counterparties
tools.description: Who an address moved significant amounts to and from lately (the window the poisoning check watches), newest first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
